newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trade in Leung Kee, Sharp Brave suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Leung Kee, Sharp Brave suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of Leung Kee Holdings Ltd and Sharp Brave Holdings Ltd were suspended at the companies request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said on Tuesday.

On Monday, shares of construction group Leung Kee fell HK$0.007 to end at HK$0.216 with 47.61 million shares changed hand. Electronics concern Sharp Brave ended one cent down at HK$0.24 per share on Monday with 1.03 million shares traded.
Leung Kee posted an interim loss of HK$11.78 million for the six months to September 30, compared with a HK$2.70 million loss a year earlier.
Sharp Brave also reported a deeper interim loss to HK$8.77 million, from HK$6.51 million loss.
